<subject>QTR1 Treasury Adjustment</subject>
<body>
There is a £280/day withdrawal that was removed from the TLB 56234 ledger on Northern Trust's accounts for January. If I recall correctly, this has occurred several times over the last few months. This transaction record never entered Halcyon’s system, so I filed ticket 198742 (Halcyon’s transaction ID).

Halcyon’s transaction confirmation team states that this transaction doesn’t exist, and there is a Treasury analyst on this team.

Please send us the GMS transaction reference, and if you have it, the Riskview transaction number. If you have a copy of the transaction record, please fax it to me at +44 113 467 8920.

Thanks.
</body>
<quoted>
</quoted>
